title: About Northwind Robotics
text:
Northwind Robotics builds piece-picking robots and the software that runs them for warehouses that handle many different products. The company was founded in 2019 and is based in Rotterdam, the Netherlands.

Northwind robots work alongside people at packing stations in e-commerce, grocery and pharmacy warehouses. Customers lease the robots and pay per pick.

Northwind Robotics is a private company. Its chief executive is Marit de Wolff, who founded the company with Joris Aalbers, the chief technology officer.
